name: google
title: Google Search
description: Search Google from the panel: Google's suggestions as you type (no key; Tab puts one in the box), a Wikipedia card for a person, place or thing, and with a provider the web results and instant answers in the pane as you type or as rows on cmd+Enter (SerpApi for Google's own results, the Brave Search API, or your own SearXNG). At the root, when nothing matches, the first suggestions join Search the web.
author: pal

settings.label: Results from
settings.description: Where the web results come from. Suggestions come from Google with no key whatever this says; no free keyless service gives results reliably (DuckDuckGo, Bing's feed, Qwant, Mojeek and Startpage refuse or answer poorly without a browser).

settings.label: SerpApi key
settings.description: From serpapi.com/manage-api-key. The free plan is 250 searches a month: with it, set Show results to When I ask. A query asked again within the hour is served from SerpApi's cache and costs nothing.

settings.label: SearXNG instance
settings.description: Its address; `json` must be among the instance's search formats (settings.yml, search.formats).

settings.label: Show results
settings.description: As you type: the pane shows the answer and the first results for the row under the cursor, a moment after you stop (one request per query, cached). When I ask: only cmd+Enter searches.

options.title: As I type, in the pane

settings.label: Language
settings.description: The language of the suggestions and results. Auto follows the system's.

settings.label: Region
settings.description: A two-letter country code for what is local (tr, us, de); empty follows the system.

settings.label: Open in
settings.description: The browser a search or a result opens in.

settings.label: At the root
settings.text: Suggestions under Search the web when nothing matches
settings.description: Asked only when nothing on the machine matched what you typed, so a query pal answered itself is never sent to Google.

settings.label: Recent searches
settings.text: Remember searches and list them while nothing is typed

store.tagline: Google's suggestions as you type, results and answers in the panel
features: Google's suggestions on every keystroke, no key needed: Enter searches, Tab puts a suggestion in the box, cmd+b searches in the background
A person, place or thing Google recognises shows its line and thumbnail, and its Wikipedia card in the pane
With a provider, the answer (the weather, a conversion, a definition) and the first results in the pane as you type; cmd+Enter lists them as rows to open, open in the background or copy
SerpApi for Google's own results, the Brave Search API, or your own SearXNG instance
At the root, when nothing matches, the first suggestions join Search the web; the query leaves the machine only then
Recent searches while nothing is typed; language, region, safe search and the browser in Settings
